reason: The plugin replaces the DSH bash tool’s command executor with Fish, with optional Bash-assignment translation; rejection is appropriate because the README explicitly states that it should not be used and causes more retries.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 的 bash 工具命令改由 Fish 执行，并可选地转换部分 Bash 赋值语法。
summaries.en: Runs commands submitted through DSH’s bash tool with Fish and optionally translates selected Bash assignment syntax.

capabilities: Executes model-submitted shell commands through Fish
Changes foreground and background shell command execution
Optionally translates selected Bash assignments into Fish syntax
Uses the host shell executor and may access its permitted processes and files
